headline: Sources: Colts' Keenan Allen faces minimum 3-game suspension
summary: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen, who was formally charged last week with two misdemeanor offenses stemming from his drunk-driving arrest in downtown Indianapolis last month, is facing a minimum three-game suspension, sources told ESPN.

headline: Sources: Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. could play in Week 3
summary: Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. is nearing a return and could make his 2026 debut Thursday night against the Packers, sources told ESPN.

headline: Ravens' Zay Flowers downgraded to out because of hamstring injury
summary: The Baltimore Ravens downgraded Pro Bowl wide receiver Zay Flowers to out for Sunday's game against the New Orleans Saints.

headline: NFL will no longer allow Patriots to use video board to confuse opposing kickers
summary: The Patriots' longstanding tactic of creating an optical illusion for the road team's kicker has been banned.

headline: Broncos remain confident in OC Davis Webb as playcaller
summary: The Broncos maintain a "high level of confidence and comfort" in Davis Webb as their offensive playcaller, a team source told ESPN.
